purpose: City-specific official registry/cadastre and safe anonymous parcel-geometry discovery.
assessment: Official agency sources identify a Fergana City cadastral office and a national geospatial portal. The portal’s initial view showed no loaded layer list and a terms/login panel; no acceptance, authentication, or parcel query was performed.
registryAssessment: The official Fergana regional government and Cadastre Agency sources identify a Fergana City cadastral office and the national agency’s land/property rights-registration remit. The National Geoportal offers cadastral search controls, but its public layer/schema and a safe anonymous feature response were not verified.
